import workcell, sys, time
tare=123.66
target=250.00
tolerance=0.20

def read():
    r=workcell.call('scale','read')
    if not r.ok:
        raise RuntimeError(r.text)
    return r.data['gross_g']

def dose(size):
    r=workcell.call('robot','dose',size)
    if not r.ok:
        raise RuntimeError(r.text)
    return r.text.strip()

gross=read()
net=gross-tare
print(f'start gross={gross:.2f} net={net:.2f} rem={target-net:.2f}')
for i in range(80):
    gross=read(); net=gross-tare; rem=target-net
    if -tolerance <= net-target <= tolerance:
        print(f'PASS range reached: gross={gross:.2f} net={net:.2f} rem={rem:.2f}')
        break
    if rem > 2.0:
        action='fine'
    elif rem > 0.20:
        action='micro'
    elif rem < -0.20:
        print(f'OVERDOSE: gross={gross:.2f} net={net:.2f} rem={rem:.2f}')
        action='remove'
    else:
        # net between 249.80 and 250.20? Actually if rem <=0.20 and rem >= -0.20 pass caught above.
        action=None
    if action is None:
        print('No action?', gross, net, rem)
        break
    before=read()
    res=dose(action)
    # maybe wait tiny for scale settling already in read; no sleep
    after=read()
    print(f'step {i}: {action} before={before:.2f} after={after:.2f} actual={after-before:.2f} net={after-tare:.2f} rem={target-(after-tare):.2f}')
print('final', read(), 'net', read()-tare)
